description:
VISCOCHAB is a pure 27-ODE rate system (bibfor/algorith/rkdcha.F90), not a yield surface with a consistency condition, so it shares none of the chaboche module's scalar-collapse architecture. It is a clean next tranche and rkdcha.F90 has been read and understood (parameter map coeft(1..25) to nomc(4..28) verified against cvmmat.F90). BLOCKER NEEDING A MAINTAINER RULING: outram_foam_basic_lib::ode::Rkf45 takes &dyn OdeSystem, a trait object at the call site, which the workspace no-trait-objects rule forbids. Decide whether that boundary coercion is acceptable or whether a typed-state integrator is wanted. Also flagged: likely typo in rkdcha.F90 where da2v uses (1-d1) and symmetry with the da1v line implies (1-d2).

description:
Maintainer sequencing constraint for the HTGR branch, recorded so it is not silently violated.

  - Phase 0 (helium properties, graphite properties) and Phase 1 (neutronics anchors) are LOW RISK and may proceed in parallel as background work.
  - Phase 2 onward (core thermal-hydraulics, coupled steady state, transients, BOP, process heat) must NOT start until the TAMPINES transonic HEM critical-flow V&V item is closed.

Context: the Marviken critical-flow work is live in tampines (marviken_tests.rs, test 23 validated / test 24 explicitly NOT validated and kept as an honest characterisation), and op-ja3t tracks the HEM result landing in tampines-steam-tables.

This bead exists to be checked before anyone opens Phase 2 work, and closed when the gate lifts.
title: HTGR SEQUENCING GATE: Phase 2 onward blocked on TAMPINES transonic HEM critical-flow V&V
